product.olivetti-m6-420.summary: The entry SX configuration in the first M6 family covered by the guide.
product.olivetti-m6-420.history: In April 1994, MCmicrocomputer placed the M6-4xx in Olivetti’s professional workstation range. The M6-420 was its entry-level 486SX configuration.
product.olivetti-m6-420.architecture: Memory could grow without replacing the board. The guide records 4 MB soldered and three sequential SIMM sockets. The documented board is BA2000.
product.olivetti-m6-420.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records Flash EPROM · Rev. 1.20.
product.olivetti-m6-420.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m6-420.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-420.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, §37, pp. 37-1–37-3.
